title: Tax Return
description: Indicators extracted from an individual tax return. Review assistance only — this does NOT calculate qualifying income.  EXTRACTION ONLY — this is not an underwriting decision.

total_income.description: Total income (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

adjusted_gross_income.description: AGI (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

wages.description: Wages line (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

business_income.description: Business income line (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

rental_income.description: Rental/royalty income line (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

capital_gains.description: Capital gains line (as written on the document, e.g. '3,109.28')

schedules_present.description: Schedules attached (C, E, F, K-1, etc.)

possible_losses.description: Losses that may reduce qualifying income

possible_addbacks_for_review.description: Items an underwriter may add back (depreciation, etc.)

requires_underwriting_analysis.description: Why this needs a human underwriter

potential_inconsistencies.description: Observations that look inconsistent. NOT conclusions.

missing_information.description: Fields the document should contain but does not.

human_verification_items.description: Things a human must confirm against the source before relying on them.

snippet.description: Verbatim text the value came from

source_references.description: Where each important value was found.
